messages.content: Return one JSON object only, with no code fences, with "primary_topic", "topics" and "tracking_numbers". Topics: status_question, delay, return, damage, address_change, claim_followup, billing, other. Return tracking numbers as a plain list of strings exactly as written in the message.

Hello,

I decided to return the smart watch after all, BYL260439062. It was delivered on 1 October, so today, 31 October, is day 30 and the last day of your 30 days. It is still 31 October in Cairo where your office is, so please accept the return today.

I am sorry it is late in the evening. I only got home now.

Hassan Ibrahim
